items.title: Additions to the Entity List (BIS adds 7 Megaspeed-linked entities in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand)
items.rationale: Geopolitics axis, primary document: a BIS final rule puts 7 Megaspeed-linked firms in Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand on the Entity List over the risk of diverting advanced computing items, with a license requirement and a presumption of denial. This is the first concrete export-control action in the Megaspeed probe.
items.excerpt: BIS final rule (public inspection 11-23, publication 11-25) adds MSFusion, PT Megaspeed International, Speedmatrix, Apex Enterprise Solutions (Singapore), Megaspeed International Pte, Swiftdata and Megaspeed (Thailand) to the Entity List over significant risk of diverting advanced computing commodities; all EAR items need a license, presumption of denial. Effective on public inspection.

items.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
items.rationale: Policy/liability axis, new filing: the Oregon and Virginia attorneys general sued SpaceX (owner of X and xAI), alleging that Grok image generation still produces CSAM and nonconsensual intimate imagery. The allegations are attributed to the AGs.
items.excerpt: Oregon and Virginia attorneys general filed suits against SpaceX/X over Grok image generation, alleging the AI still produces CSAM and nonconsensual intimate imagery despite X's claim every output is screened.

items.title: NY Gov. Hochul vetoes bill that would have required AI accuracy warnings
items.rationale: Policy axis, new executive decision: New York's governor vetoed a bill that would have required AI chatbots to carry accuracy warnings, citing possible free-speech conflicts. This directly affects chatbot builders. The outlet is off-list; no on-list outlet covered the veto.
items.excerpt: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul vetoed a bill requiring AI chatbots to carry accuracy warnings, saying the measure may run afoul of free-speech protections.

items.title: AI 안경 '몰카' 막는다…촬영 표시 의무화 법안 발의
items.rationale: Policy axis, new bill: a National Assembly bill sponsored by Rep. Lee Ju-hee would require AI smart glasses to show a recording indicator and to notify people when filming in private settings. It is a hardware-level obligation for device makers.
items.excerpt: AI 스마트안경에 촬영 표시 기능 탑재를 의무화하고 사적 촬영 시 촬영 사실 고지를 의무화하는 법안(이주희 의원 대표발의)이 국회에 발의됐다.

items.title: 배경훈 부총리 "국가과학AI센터, 과학AI 허브 자리잡도록 지원"
items.rationale: National AI strategy axis, official release: a Ministry of Science and ICT plan (11-23 press release) concentrates national science-AI capacity in the National AI Research Center for Science (NAIS), a sovereign-AI R&D program.
items.excerpt: 과기정통부가 국가과학인공지능연구센터(NAIS)를 중심으로 국가 과학 AI 역량을 결집하는 계획을 밝혔다 (과기정통부 11-23 보도자료 '국가 과학 인공지능 역량 결집해 초지능 과학 혁신을 선도한다').
